latHint: Think tents, camels, and no fixed address.
pivHint: A ROVER explores another planet - but a ROVER is also a wanderer with no fixed home, a ______.
winText: Always on the move. ROVER was the pivot - a planet explorer to a wandering NOMAD.
lossText: NOMAD - one who roams with no fixed home. ROVER was the pivot: a space ROVER, and a human ROVER, a NOMAD.
